title: How Optimality Structures Sparse Dictionaries: Theory for Interpreting SAE Representations
abstract: arXiv:2606.02385v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have found success parsing neural network representations into interpretable concepts, providing a basis for understanding and control. However, what exactly SAEs extract and, hence, the scientific conclusions we can draw from them are not obvious. In short, if your SAE behaves strangely, does that reflect interesting neural network behaviour or an SAE-imposed distortion? Towards answering this, we use dictionary learning identifiability results to derive constraints that optimal dictionary learning features must satisfy. For example, an optimal feature will never turn on only while another is active. We use these conditions to explain various SAE oddities - hierarchical splitting & absorption, which features can be left in the residuals, dense antipodal features, and infinite feature splitting - simply as properties imposed by the dictionary learning objective. translated_title: 最优性如何结构化稀疏字典：用于解释SAE表示的理论
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）在将神经网络表示解析为可解释概念方面取得了成功，为模型的理解与控制提供了基础。然而，SAE究竟提取了什么，以及我们由此能够得出怎样的科学结论，并不显而易见。简而言之，如果你的SAE表现出奇怪的行为，这究竟反映了神经网络中有趣的现象，还是SAE自身强加的失真？为了回答这一问题，我们利用字典学习的可辨识性结果，推导出最优字典学习特征必须满足的约束条件。例如，一个最优特征绝不会仅在另一个特征激活时才被激活。我们利用这些条件解释了SAE的多种反常现象——层级分裂与吸收、哪些特征可以留在残差中、密集的对跖特征，以及无限的特征分裂——并将其归结为字典学习目标函数本身所强加的属性。最后，这些约束条件在诊断上具有……
tldr: 该论文利用字典学习的可辨识性理论推导出最优稀疏字典特征必须满足的约束条件，从而将SAE的各种反常现象（如层级分裂、残差特征、密集对跖特征等）解释为字典学习目标函数本身的内在属性，而非神经网络中有趣的真实行为。
en_tdlr: This paper derives constraints that optimal dictionary learning features must satisfy using identifiability theory, explaining various SAE oddities—such as hierarchical splitting and absorption, residual features, and dense antipodal features—as inherent properties of the dictionary learning objective rather than interesting neural network behavior.
